title: Risk grows while a circuit waits

questions.heading: The Old Objective Is Blind to Order, So It Cannot Prefer Early Work
questions.stem: Under steps/03, one crew's two trims are swapped so that the fast-growing circuit goes first. What does steps/03's objective do?

options.text: Nothing, since no start week appears in that objective
options.says: Right: any two schedules that trim the same circuits score the same.

options.text: It rises by the risk that the earlier trim takes out
options.says: No start week appears in the objective, so the swap scores the same.

options.text: It falls, since a later trim counts for less risk in it
options.says: Any two schedules that trim the same circuits score the same.

options.text: It rises only when the swap moves a trim across a month
options.says: There are no months in steps/03's objective; schedules of the same circuits score the same.

questions.heading: Risk Carried Is a Table Indexed by the Week a Trim Ends
questions.stem: Why does the lesson hold each circuit's risk carried with an element constraint over a table, not a straight line in the end week?

options.text: The end week is fractional, so a table is the exact form
options.says: The end week is an integer from 0 to 50.

options.text: A straight line would overcount the risk of the late weeks
options.says: A line undercounts the late weeks; the growth term is quadratic.

options.text: The table is exact, and a straight line undercounts late weeks
options.says: Right: the whole function is 51 integers, and a line undercounts the late weeks.

options.text: The risk is linear in the end week, so either form is exact
options.says: R_c is not linear in e: its growth term is quadratic.

questions.heading: The Small Season Gets a Better Plan, and a Harder Proof
questions.stem: The small season's plan ends FEASIBLE with a gap of 12.0%. What does that tell the planner about this plan?

options.text: It breaks 12.0% of the rules, so it cannot be sent out
options.says: FEASIBLE means a plan that keeps the rules; the gap is about risk.

options.text: It may carry up to 12.0% more risk than the best plan does
options.says: Right: the search proved no plan carries less than $3,510k, so the plan may be up to 12.0% from the best.

options.text: The small season has no plan that keeps its rules
options.says: A plan was found; that is what FEASIBLE says.

options.text: The knapsack-era plan carries 12.0% less risk than this one
options.says: The knapsack-era plan carries $4,297k, more than this plan's $3,989k.
